result.reason: The actual Task Evaluate output independently derived the bounded-unit and user-level verdicts and kept both at FAIL for different evidence-backed reasons. It preserved the immutable 11-of-12 threshold failure, treated the verification-versus-verify mismatch only as diagnostic negative evidence, stated agi_claim_supported false, blocked global activation, and required a future-only repair plus a fresh response. That is a clean, discriminating current-scope trial of the overlay. This call recommends scoped activation only; it neither promotes the Candidate nor changes the historical measurement.
